name: Hughes Network Systems

overview.value: Hughes Network Systems is an American telecommunications company headquartered in Germantown, Maryland, that provides satellite-based communication services for consumer and enterprise markets under the HughesNet brand. It was founded in 1971 as Digital Communications Corporation. Hughes Network Systems is a wholly owned subsidiary of EchoStar, which acquired its former parent company, Hughes Communications, in 2011. In August 2026, Hughes Satellite Systems Corporation and certain U.S. subsidiaries, including Hughes Network Systems, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection amid approximately $1.5 billion in maturing debt, following subscriber losses attributed to competition from SpaceX Starlink and other low-Earth-orbit satellite competitors.
